title: Put your app live
content:
## What you'll get

One click turns your preview into a real, live website anyone can visit - at a permanent URL that stays up 24/7.

---

## Deploy your app

Once you've built and tested your app in the preview environment, you're ready to go live.

<Steps>

<Step title="Click Deploy">
In the workspace, find the **Deploy** button. This starts the deployment process - Emergent provisions production infrastructure and packages your app for the web.
</Step>

<Step title="Wait for the build">
The first deployment takes around **15 minutes** while the platform sets up servers, runs health checks, and spins up your app. Grab a coffee - you'll see progress updates in the workspace.
</Step>

<Step title="Get your live URL">
When deployment finishes, you'll receive a permanent, public URL like `https://your-app-name.emergent.app`. This link works immediately and stays live as long as your app is deployed.
</Step>

</Steps>

<Callout type="info" title="Video coming soon">
A short screen recording will go here.
</Callout>

<Callout type="success" title="Your app is live">
Share the URL with anyone - no login required unless you've built authentication into your app. The link is permanent and won't change when you update your app later.
</Callout>

---

## Your app runs separately from preview

Here's an important detail: **the deployed app is a completely separate environment from your preview workspace.**

When you make changes in preview - fixing a bug, tweaking the design, adding a feature - those updates stay in preview only. Your live app keeps serving the last version you deployed, so you never accidentally break things for real users while you're still experimenting.

To push updates to your live app, you'll **Redeploy** (for code changes) or **Replace** (if you've changed the database structure). Both options are covered in [Preview vs Deployed (separate)](/preview-vs-deployed-separate).

<Callout type="note" title="Safe iteration">
This separation means you can test freely in preview without worrying about your live users. Deploy updates only when you're ready.
</Callout>

---

## What deployment costs

A deployed app costs **50 credits per month** while it's live. This covers hosting, bandwidth, health monitoring, and automatic scaling.

If you shut down the deployment (from the workspace), billing stops immediately. You can redeploy the same app anytime without losing your work - Emergent keeps your code and project history.

For details on topping up credits, see [Credit expiry & recharging](/credit-expiry-recharging).

---

## Shutting down a deployed app

You can shut down a live app at any time from the workspace. This stops the app, releases the infrastructure, and halts the monthly charge.

<Callout type="warning" title="Databases persist">
Shutting down a deployment does not delete any databases or external services your app uses. If you want to remove data, you'll need to delete those resources separately. See [Database (MongoDB)](/database-mongodb) for details.
</Callout>

To bring the app back online later, just click **Deploy** again.

---

## If something looks wrong

After your first deployment, open the live URL in a fresh browser tab (or on your phone) and walk through your app as a user would. The production build is optimized differently from preview, so it's worth a quick check.

If you spot an issue, make the fix in preview, test it thoroughly, then redeploy. The live URL stays the same - your users won't notice anything except that the bug disappeared.

For monitoring tools, logs, and troubleshooting slow or crashed apps, see [Deploying (web)](/deploying-web).
